basic_details.organization_name: Deputy Director of Health Services (DDHS Latur)
basic_details.short_information: The Deputy Director of Health Services, Latur (DDHS Latur) has officially announced the Project Coordinator Recruitment 2026 with 1 opening. The detailed notification has been published at https://arogya.maharashtra.gov.in/. Candidates up to 38 years of age and holding BE/ B.Tech, BCA/ MCA, MBA/ Post Graduate Diploma in Management, or a Master's in Public Health can submit their offline applications up to 10 August 2026. Direct links to download the official notification and application form are available below.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 38 years. Age relaxation: Up to 43 years for reserved categories; 5 years relaxation for in-service NHM candidates.

qualification.education_qualification: BE/ B-Tech, BCA/ MCA, MBA/ Post Graduate Diploma in Management, Master's in Public Health
qualification.details: BE/ B-Tech or BCA/ MCA or MBA/ Post Graduate Diploma in Management or Master's in Public Health from a Recognized Institute.

selection_process: Merit based on Qualifying Exam (50 marks) Additional Educational Qualification (20 marks) Relevant Experience (30 marks)
how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://nhm.maharashtra.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DDHS Latur Project Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DDHS Latur Project Coordinator post is 10 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/B-Tech, BCA/MCA, MBA/Post Graduate Diploma in Management, or a Master's in Public Health from a recognized institution to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Coordinator post is 38 years. Age relaxation is provided for reserved categories and in-service NHM candidates.

faq.question: Q4. How much is the application fee for the DDHS Latur recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 150/- for the Open Category and Rs. 100/- for Reserved Categories, payable via Demand Draft.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Coordinator role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 50,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves merit based on the qualifying exam (50 marks), additional educational qualifications (20 marks), and relevant experience (30 marks).

faq.question: Q7. Is this a contractual job?
faq.answer: Yes, the Project Coordinator position is a contractual role under the Deputy Director of Health Services, Latur.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it along with required documents to the address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website: nhm.maharashtra.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Project Coordinator in this recruitment drive.
